statement: In normalized x=r/R_b units, F_in=a2 x^2 and F_out=c_ext x^-3 with value matching gives c_ext=a2.
The 3180 core plus shell signed projected moment matches the boundary identity.
The absolute projected-source norm is larger because core and shell partially cancel.
For the normalized sharp-shell profile, P_H reduces to the compact product s_K2*kappa_STF*a2.
